title: Disclosing Public Sector Scope 3 Emissions under GreenGov.SG Initiative
what_it_is: Disclosing Public Sector Scope 3 Emissions under GreenGov.SG Initiative

sections.label: Public sector Scope 3 emissions
sections.summary: The Government says it is not requiring disclosure of public sector Scope 3 emissions under GreenGov.SG, and will refine its framework progressively.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment whether the Government will disclose public sector Scope 3 emissions under the GreenGov.SG initiative.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will refine our framework as we strive to reduce our emissions and develop greater capability within the public service for tracking and reporting.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Is there a timeline within which the Government will be looking to consider introducing reporting of Scope 3 emissions, because the Minister mentioned that this is going to be reviewed progressively.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: At this point in time, just like to reiterate that we are not requiring disclosure of Scope 3 emissions.
